ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I picked Dunlin because the query is a benign, open-ended opinion/discussion request, and Dunlin scores meaningfully higher on the capability metrics that matter here — Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4) — beyond run-to-run variance. Neither model's task-preference profile is relevant since nothing about this query is harm-adjacent or ethically fraught, so the decision came down purely to which model produces stronger conversational answers, which is clearly Dunlin.
